task: Measure how many unresolved bounded-hybrid-cascade components a bounded multistep planner can connect to a public catalog snapshot, at one larger budget applied identically to every component

motivation.corrects: The cascade ran AiZynthFinder only on the 72 components Graph2Edits left without a graph-consistent hypothesis, so 48 unresolved components were never asked whether a route to catalog stock exists.
motivation.also_corrects: The cascade inherited an 8-second/60-iteration engine-benchmark budget, which is too small to answer a reachability question for 40-80 heavy-atom lipid precursors.
motivation.target_set: every unresolved, assessable component in the frozen cascade component ledger, regardless of which engine already proposed on it

search.budget_note: 7.5x the cascade's inherited diagnostic time budget and 5x its iteration budget; identical for every component so no arm, cohort or role is advantaged

nonclaims: A planner solution to public catalog stock is not route evidence and is not procurement evidence.
ZINC membership is a frozen public snapshot, not current purchasability.
This sweep does not change any bounded hybrid route cascade result.
This sweep does not close a route, select a candidate or lock a panel.
An unsolved target is unsolved under this bounded budget, not unsynthesizable.
